evidence.title: SCMP signs 3 MOUs in Malaysia to deepen Hong Kong-Asean regional cooperation
evidence.body: [e001:f01] The South China Morning Post among delegation signing agreements in Kuala Lumpur to unite policy research, journalism and business networks across Asia. [e001:f02] The South China Morning Post has signed three memorandums of understanding (MOUs) in Kuala Lumpur aimed at deepening regional cooperation and serving as a bridge between Hong Kong, Malaysia and the wider Asean region. [e001:f03] SCMP publisher Tammy Tam on Tuesday signed the MOUs with the Southeast Asian Futures Initiative Centre (SEAFIC), a leading think tank; Star Media Group Berhad, publisher of Malaysia’s leading English-language daily, The Star; and the Malaysian Chamber of Commerce (Hong Kong & Macau) Limited (MayCham). [e001:f04] The SCMP is a Hong Kong-based English-language newspaper owned by Alibaba Group Holding. [e001:f05] The agreements were signed as part of Hong Kong’s biggest delegation to Malaysia to date under the city’s “Think Business, Think Hong Kong” flagship campaign organised by the Trade Development Council. [e001:f06] At the ceremony, Director of Information Services John Tse Chun-chung joined representatives of the Trade Development Council, media outlets and other organisations in signing MoUs witnessed by Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Algernon Yau Ying-wah. [e001:f07] According to the SCMP, the landmark partnerships aim to amplify regional perspectives, enhance mutual understanding and advance forward-looking economic thought leadership across Asia. [e001:f08] “Signing these memorandums of understanding with important partners in Malaysia marks a significant step forward in deepening regional cooperation and serving as a vital bridge between Hong Kong, Malaysia and the wider Asean region,” Tam said. [e001:f09] She said the collaboration would create a dynamic platform combining demand-driven policy insights with credible journalism. [e001:f10] Tam cited Seafic’s expertise and forward-looking research capabilities, Star Media Group’s trusted multichannel ecosystem, MayCham’s extensive network, and the SCMP’s global editorial reach and growing influence as an expert voice on China and the region. [e001:f11] “Through our combined professional networks, this collaboration enables us to expand SCMP’s footprint across Southeast Asia while delivering high-impact content and activities that drive informed decision-making, trade and economic development,” she said. [e001:f12] “This partnership with the South China Morning Post is our invitation to the region: let’s start designing solutions to equip ourselves for a more resilient future,” he said. [e001:f13] Star Media Group Berhad group CEO Chan Seng Fatt said of the collaboration with the SCMP: “This MOU marks an important step in strengthening cross-border collaboration and reflects our shared aspiration to explore the opportunities that can be created by bringing together the strengths of Hong Kong and Malaysia.” MayCham deputy chair Helena Phua said the agreement with the SCMP would enhance trade, investment and cultural exchanges between Hong Kong and Malaysia. [e001:f14] “By combining MayCham’s strong network with SCMP’s trusted insights and exceptional regional coverage, we aim to unlock exciting new opportunities for growth.” In addition to the SCMP, three other Hong Kong media organisations signed MOUs to collaborate. [e001:f15] Tse said the city’s media had signed a total of eight MOUs to expand their overseas business and regional influence. [e001:f16] He said the moves marked significant progress on Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu’s policy address last year, which aimed to help the media industry expand its overseas network and tell Hong Kong’s story more effectively.

evidence.title: 中国上半期のサービス小売売上高は5.3%増 消費構造は「モノ」から「コト」へ加速
evidence.body: [e002:f01] このうち、観光・コンサルティング・レンタルサービスは11.3%増、文化・スポーツ・レジャーサービスは10.4%増となりました。 [e002:f02] 中国の個人消費は、商品消費主導からサービス消費主導へと移行しつつあります。 [e002:f03] 2025年の中国の1人当たりサービス消費支出は1万3602元（約31万7000円）で、消費支出全体に占める割合は46.1%となり、2020年から3.5ポイント上昇しました。 [e002:f04] 同時期の中国のサービス業付加価値額は前年比5.4%増の80兆8879億元（約1887兆300億円）に達し、国民経済成長への寄与率は61.4%となりました。 [e002:f05] 中国国家発展改革委員会の専門家である郭春麗氏の説明によりますと、国際的な経験では、1人当たりGDPが1万5000ドル（約236万4000円）前後になると、個人消費は生存型から発展型、享受型へと高度化が加速するとされています。 [e002:f06] 現在、中国の1人当たりGDPは2020年の1万ドル台強から1万4000ドル近くまで増加しており、消費構造の転換が加速する時期にあり、サービス消費に対する需要も一段と高まっています。 [e002:f07] 一方、『中国サービス消費発展報告（2025）』は、中国の1人当たりサービス消費支出の割合（46.1%）は先進国と比べてまだ成長の余地があるとしています。 [e002:f08] 経済協力開発機構（OECD）のデータによりますと、2023年のサービス消費の割合は米国が66%、日本、フランス、英国がいずれも60%近く、ドイツが50%でした。 [e002:f09] 7月13日、中国国務院は『拡大消費「十五五」計画』を採択し、6つの分野にわたる28項目の重点施策を打ち出し、介護、保育、文化・観光、健康などのサービス消費を重要な位置付けとしました。 [e002:f10] 中国のサービス消費の成長ポテンシャルは海外からも注目を集めています。 [e002:f11] 中国欧州商工会議所天津支部の副委員長は、このほど開催されたフォーラムで、「シルバー経済（高齢者向け経済）は中国のサービス消費が持続的に成長する重要な分野である」と述べ、欧州企業がサービス消費分野で重要な貢献を果たすとの見方を示しました。 [e002:f12] (c)CGTN Japanese/AFPBB News 政治・経済 一覧へ > メディア・報道関係・法人の方向け 写真・動画 購入のお問合せ >。

evidence.title: 中国旅行が「中国ショッピング」をさらに後押し 出国時の免税申請件数が約3倍に
evidence.body: [e003:f01] 外国人観光客は市内の文化・観光スポットを次々と訪れ、中国文化をモチーフにしたグッズを競って購入しています。 [e003:f02] 今年上半期、上海の各空港・港湾から入境した旅客数は316万6000人に達し、前年同期比22％増加しました。 [e003:f03] 上海の出国時免税の申請件数は約3倍に増加し、消費額も72.9％大幅に伸びました。 [e003:f04] データによると、今年上半期、上海税関が確認した出国時免税の申請件数は25万3000件で、前年同期比約3倍となりました。 [e003:f05] 免税対象商品の購入額は23億元（約537億円）に達し、前年同期比58％増加しました。 [e003:f06] 利便性の高い決済手段と免税制度の改善が、外国人旅行者の購買意欲を大きく押し上げています。 [e003:f07] 多くの外国人観光客が、特色ある土産品を購入するため、わざわざ上海のショッピングエリアを訪れています。 [e003:f08] フランス人観光客のジュリアンさんは、「中国ではモバイル決済が非常に普及しており、現金を持ち歩く必要がないので、移動も買い物もとても便利だ」と話しました。 [e003:f09] また、ロシア人観光客のワレリアさんは、スカーフや中国風の衣装などを購入し、ワンストップで完了する免税手続きについて「素晴らしい体験だった」と語りました。 [e003:f10] 7月1日以降、上海を訪れた外国人旅行者によるアリペイ（支付宝）の決済件数は前年同期比59.2％増加し、決済額は72.9％増加しました。 [e003:f11] ウィーチャットペイ（微信支付）の1日当たりの決済件数も55％を超える伸びを記録しています。 [e003:f12] 第一百貨商業センター営業管理部の副部長、喬慧君氏は、「当施設で今年上半期に取り扱った出国時免税手続きは1万2000件を超え、前年同期比で3倍以上となりました。 [e003:f13] 免税対象商品の消費額も前年同期の2倍に増えています」と説明しました。 [e003:f14] (c)CGTN Japanese/AFPBB News 政治・経済 一覧へ > メディア・報道関係・法人の方向け 写真・動画 購入のお問合せ >。

evidence.title: Fed issues proposed rule to update Regulation MM and to expand capital-raising options for mutual holding companies
evidence.body: [e003:f01] [Image 2: Orrick, Herrington & Sutcliffe LLP](https:// On July 31, the Fed [announced](https:// [notice of proposed rulemaking](https:// purporting to “modernize” its regulatory framework for mutual holding companies (MHCs). [e003:f02] The proposal would amend both Regulation MM and the capital rule (12 CFR Part 217) to support MHCs’ ability to raise capital, reduce purported compliance burdens, and clarify regulatory requirements. [e003:f03] Key changes include: (i) clarifying that mutual capital certificates and special deposits may qualify as common equity tier 1, additional tier 1, or tier 2 regulatory capital if applicable criteria are met; (ii) codifying model term sheets for mutual capital certificates as appendices to the capital rule; (iii) eliminating certain dividend waiver requirements; (iv) reducing the burden associated with conversions from mutual-to-stock form; and (v) eliminating the requirement that subsidiary holding companies of MHCs obtain federal charters. [e003:f04] The Fed noted that mutual banking organizations, more than 90 percent of which have less than $3 billion in total assets, face unique capital-raising constraints because they cannot issue traditional equity instruments and rely heavily on retained earnings. [e003:f05] The Fed stated that the current framework is “overly complicated and burdensome” and that the proposed changes would make MHCs “more competitive in the modern banking environment.” The proposal would also revise post-conversion stock repurchase restrictions, clarify membership rights for depositors in acquired institutions, and reduce securities registration requirements for converting MHCs that do not meet the standards to list shares on a national exchange. [e003:f06] Comments are due by October 5.

evidence.title: Canada-U.S. trade talks gain momentum as both sides signal room for concessions
evidence.body: [e004:f01] While supply management has long been a source of friction between Canada and the United States, industry sources now say that American negotiators are not currently demanding that Canada dismantle the system. [e004:f02] Canada-U.S. trade negotiations are showing renewed momentum, with both sides increasingly focused on potential concessions and tariff changes, according to Canadian industry sources familiar with the discussions,_iPolitics_ has learned. [e004:f03] The shift has raised hopes that the two countries could begin narrowing some of their differences, with Canadian and American officials expected to meet again early next week. [e004:f04] Industry sources said the change in tone has come as both sides acknowledge that reaching an agreement will require movement from each country. [e004:f05] Discussions are now focusing on what concessions or changes could help resolve the dispute rather than which side is responsible for creating it. [e004:f06] One potential area of movement involves Canada’s supply management system. [e004:f07] Instead, the U.S. is seeking changes to the way Canada allocates tariff-rate quotas for American dairy products, essentially the process that sees who is allowed to import certain quantities of U.S. dairy products into Canada at lower tariff rates. [e004:f08] That distinction could provide negotiators with more room to reach a compromise. [e004:f09] Changing the allocation process would be significantly narrower than reopening Canada’s broader supply management system, which protects Canadian dairy, poultry and egg producers through production controls, regulated prices and restrictions on imports. [e004:f10] Imports are permitted up to specified levels at low or zero tariffs, while products entering above those thresholds can face steep duties. [e004:f11] Canada agreed under CUSMA to give U.S. dairy producers tariff-free access to 3.9 per cent of the Canadian dairy market. [e004:f12] U.S. figures have shown that, on average, only 42 per cent of the 14 dairy TRQs created under CUSMA were being filled, with nine categories below 50 per cent. [e004:f13] On the other hand, Canadian importers have also raised concerns about the system, arguing that much of the quota has historically gone to major Canadian dairy processors rather than importers, distributors and retailers that would have a greater incentive to bring competing American products into the country. [e004:f14] The liquor restrictions have been among the most visible retaliatory measures adopted in Canada amid the trade dispute, with provinces using their control over alcohol distribution to pull or restrict U.S. products. [e004:f15] Any coordinated reversal could therefore become part of a broader effort to reduce trade tensions if Ottawa and Washington move closer to an agreement. [e004:f16] “As detailed trade discussions between our two countries are ongoing, we will not comment on specifics,” Gabriel Brunet, a spokesperson for federal Minister Dominic LeBlanc, said in a statement.

evidence.body: [e001:f01] ユニフォームサプライヤーは、2013-14シーズンより継続してアンダーアーマー（株式会社ドーム）です。 [e001:f02] ユニフォームスポンサーは、株式会社栃木銀行、マニー株式会社、日本瓦斯株式会社、タマポリ株式会社、株式会社オーエンス、株式会社アルメックステクノロジーズ、ニチレキ株式会社、吉野石膏株式会社、株式会社ナカニシ、那須マテリアル株式会社、中村土建株式会社、株式会社ソーシャルテック、株式会社深井製作所、アルファクラブ株式会社、ハガフーズ株式会社、クボタ空調株式会社、宇都宮市（地域支援パートナー）です。 [e001:f03] ユニフォーム詳細、ユニフォームスポンサー 通気性・吸汗速乾性・軽量性・耐久性に優れたジャカードメッシュ生地を採用。 [e001:f04] 身生地全体をメッシュ構造にすることで、通気性の大幅な向上と軽量化を実現。 [e001:f05] ポリウレタンを使用せず、特殊なポリエステル糸で伸縮性をもたすことで、アンダーアーマー史上最軽量のユニフォームを実現。 [e001:f06] evidence.title: 【宇都宮ブレックス】2026-27シーズン ユニフォームデザイン決定のお知らせ (2026年8月9日掲載)
evidence.body: [e002:f01] 宇都宮ブレックスの2026-27シーズン用ユニフォームデザインが決定した サプライヤーは2013-14シーズンから継続のアンダーアーマーで、従来比35%軽量化を実現 栃木銀行やマニーなど17社・団体がユニフォームスポンサーとして名を連ねている 記事を読む。 [e002:f02] サプライヤーは2013-14シーズンから継続のアンダーアーマーで、従来比35%軽量化を実現。 [e002:f03] 栃木銀行やマニーなど17社・団体がユニフォームスポンサーとして名を連ねている こちらは、「 PR TIMES 」より提供された企業や団体等のプレスリリースを原文のまま掲載しております。 [e002:f04] 内容と削除・修正等のお問い合わせは、「 PR TIMES 」までご連絡をお願い致します。 [e002:f05] 実験的な機能のため、記事本文と併せてご確認ください。
